mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization student_organization JOIN sys_organization_admin organization_admin ON organization_admin.organization_id = student_organization.organization_id WHERE student_organization.student_id = #{studentId} AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE' AND organization_admin.user_id = #{userId})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND organization_id = #{organizationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu_student_organization (id, student_id, organization_id, relation_type, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{studentId}, #{organizationId}, 'ENROLLMENT', 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization student_organization JOIN sys_organization enrollment_organization ON enrollment_organization.id = student_organization.organization_id JOIN sys_organization class_organization ON class_organization.id = #{classOrganizationId} WHERE student_organization.student_id = #{studentId} AND student_organization.relation_type = 'ENROLLMENT' AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE' AND class_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(enrollment_organization.organization_path, '%'))

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student student JOIN edu_student_organization student_organization ON student_organization.student_id = student.id JOIN sys_organization related_organization ON related_organization.id = student_organization.organization_id JOIN sys_organization target_organization ON target_organization.id = #{organizationId} WHERE student.id = #{studentId} AND student.status = 'ENABLED' AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE' AND related_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(target_organization.organization_path, '%'))

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student student JOIN edu_student_organization student_organization ON student_organization.student_id = student.id WHERE student.id = #{studentId} AND student.status = 'ENABLED' AND student_organization.organization_id = #{classOrganizationId} AND student_organization.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE')

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student student JOIN edu_student_organization student_organization ON student_organization.student_id = student.id JOIN edu_teacher_class teacher_class ON teacher_class.class_organization_id = student_organization.organization_id WHERE student.id = #{studentId} AND student.status = 'ENABLED' AND student_organization.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE' AND teacher_class.teacher_user_id = #{teacherUserId} AND teacher_class.status = 'ACTIVE')

SELECT DISTINCT student.id FROM edu_student student JOIN edu_student_organization student_organization ON student_organization.student_id = student.id JOIN sys_organization related_organization ON related_organization.id = student_organization.organization_id JOIN sys_organization target_organization ON target_organization.id = #{organizationId} WHERE student.status = 'ENABLED' AND student_organization.status = 'ACTIVE' AND related_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(target_organization.organization_path, '%') ORDER BY student.id
SELECT organization_id FROM edu_student_organization WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND relation_type = 'CLASS' AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY organization_id
mapper.update: UPDATE edu_student_organization SET status = 'INACTIVE', effective_to = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND relation_type = 'CLASS' AND status = 'ACTIVE'
